objective: remove upstream task leakage before fitting downstream world-assisted rankers

oof_scoring.property: each pair is scored only by a checkpoint whose training and inner validation sets exclude its user task

downstream_evaluation.probability_selection: five-fold grouped OOF Brier over task-out-of-model features
downstream_evaluation.ranking_training: within-user-task pairwise logistic differences over task-out-of-model features
downstream_evaluation.validation_split: existing 14 grouped-val tasks, disjoint from all 68 outer-crossfit tasks
downstream_evaluation.primary_gate: same predeclared 0.03 pairwise gain, -0.02 CI lower, and +0.01 Brier tolerance versus clean and strongest text

interpretation_constraints: Grouped validation and all grouped-test outcomes have already been inspected, so this is a mechanism-correction experiment rather than pristine external confirmation.
A positive post-hoc result on the 15 fresh tasks would still require new tasks or an outer benchmark for confirmation.
No additional Llama-70B replay is authorized by this protocol.
